text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that a 40 km/h speed limit be implemented on the entire stretch of Silverstone Drive, between Finch Avenue West and Martin Grove Road as the warrants are satisfied. Currently, the speed limit on Silverstone Drive, between Finch Avenue West and Martin Grove Road varies between 40 km/h and 50 km/h. This proposal will provide consistency in terms of the speed limit on this portion of Silverstone Drive.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Silverstone Drive, between a point 218 metres south of Midhurst Drive and Finch Avenue West. 2. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Silverstone Drive, between Midhurst Drive and Tinton Crescent (north intersection).
